title: Don't Sleep!
description: Allow players to toggle a placeholder to let other players know not to sleep. (Great for servers with farms that need nighttime!)
body:
# Overview
*Allow players to toggle a placeholder to let other players know not to sleep.*

This is for vanilla-esque SMPs that allow AFKing farms. This specifically helps if a farm that is being AFKed needs to run during Minecraft night. This lets the other players know not to sleep via a placeholder!

This is extremely useful for SMPs where players AFK overnight and many people leave and join the server or if no one is on the server when the player starts AFKing (so they cannot inform anyone to not sleep).

# Features
- Placeholder to put into tab or the side bar.
  - An off **and** on status (different messages) (configurable).
- Command to toggle this placeholder.
  - With permissions.

# Future Plans
- (Configurable) Notification when someone wants players to not sleep. (**Coming soon!**)

# Requirements
- BukkitOfUtils.
- Paper / Spigot / Bukkit / Purpur / Forks server.
